item.title: metacheck: 3 commits today
item.description:
scienceverse/metacheck

Summary unavailable.

3 commit(s) today:

  • 50f3c0c [dev] Merge pull request #701 from scienceverse/fix_699_download_limits — Daniel Lakens
  • 178dfdd [dev] An archive downloaded whole to take files out of it is held to max_file_size as well, in download_repo_files() and in code_check's zip reading (#699): on the Meta-Psychology papers, an OSF zip of 20.5 MB reported as left out by a 20 MB limit was still downloaded whole. — Lakens
  • 463cd30 [dev] Download limits, first part of #699: no download path without a limit; ResearchBox held to the limits; GEO, ENA and ArrayExpress records whose archive did not answer are "unreachable", not "unfound". Version 0.4.4.28 — Lakens
  • 08c7171 [dev] Merge pull request #697 from scienceverse/fix_695_541 — Daniel Lakens
  • 998d99e [dev] test-data-read: build the IDate test table without tibble(), which with vctrs 0.7 refuses an IDate stored as decimal numbers — Lakens
  • be1678d [dev] download_repo_files() keeps to one max_download_size budget per repository, shared by archive members and files with their own address, counting the cache first (#698) — Lakens
  • e696c85 [dev] Five faults from the Meta-Psychology run (#695) and the OSF part of #541: PsychArchives DOIs are looked up and listed; ref_replication no longer suggests the citing paper itself; stat_check reads a test as one-sided when its sentence says so; extract_p_values() reads "p one-sided =" and "p (two-tailed) ="; files read from web addresses are not reported as missing; the stand-in for a failed reproducibility_check run is named; osf_type() returns "unreachable" for a failed request, and prereg_check and the OSF app say the link could not be checked. Version 0.4.4.27 — Lakens
  • d865ecb [dev] Merge pull request #692 from scienceverse/fix_679_osf_storage_totals — Daniel Lakens
  • 3b4255e [dev] OSF storage totals come only from listings of whole storages, so a link to single files no longer fetches the project's whole storage as a zip; a storage's zip gets time for its size and number of files; files of an OSF add-on storage (GitHub) are kept apart from OSF Storage files under the same path (#679). Version 0.4.4.25 — Lakens
  • 7b8c711 [main] Merge pull request #691 from scienceverse/dev — Daniel Lakens
  • af00acc [dev] Merge pull request #689 from scienceverse/fix_685_key_remove — Daniel Lakens
  • e153c74 [dev] Merge pull request #690 from scienceverse/checks_light_dev — Daniel Lakens
  • 1d5fad6 [checks_light_dev] R CMD check: a pull request into dev is checked once, on Linux with the released R, without CRAN's settings and failing on errors only; all seven systems with CRAN's settings for main, the weekly run and a run by hand — Lakens
  • 585d8cc [checks_light_dev] Merge pull request #686 from scienceverse/fix_680_unzip_all — Daniel Lakens
  • a11efe1 [dev] Removing keys from a module's result takes time in step with its size, not in the square of the number of texts: 95 minutes for one reproducibility_check result (#685). Version 0.4.4.24 — Lakens
  • 4351276 [checks_light_dev] Merge pull request #688 from scienceverse/fix_682_name_particles — Daniel Lakens
  • 3372ee7 [checks_light_dev] Merge pull request #684 from scienceverse/tro_provenance — Daniel Lakens
  • 431dfc3 [checks_light_dev] Merge pull request #683 from scienceverse/fix_report_file_tabs — Daniel Lakens
  • d3b7d7d [checks_light_dev] Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/fix_681_osf_incomplete' into fix_680_unzip_all — Lakens
